mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate at 0.1% is at a historically low level, compressing discount rates and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in the federal funds rate above 4.5% and CPIAUCSL above 3.5% signal a dual threat of monetary tightening and high inflation, compressing equity valuations and increasing risk premiums, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 4.5% and CPIAUCSL > 3.5% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current unemployment rate of 8.4% signals a weak labor market, prompting the Federal Reserve to implement monetary easing, which increases equity valuations and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, increasing the risk of premature monetary tightening and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0% over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts below 1400 thousand units and retail sales below 500000 million dollars signal a weakening demand environment, increasing the risk of recession and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when both HOUST < 1400 and RSAFS < 500000 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a demand slowdown regime characterized by housing starts below 1500 thousand units and unemployment above 7.0%, a decline in housing starts (HOUST < 1500) signals a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: demand slowdown and labor market weakness (HOUST<1500 and UNRATE>7.0%)
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when the regime condition (HOUST<1500 and UNRATE>7.0%) is met over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100 (2017=100) signals a weakening economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the Federal Reserve is expected to ease monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 100 over a 3-year rolling window.
